resources.string: This app draws the iPhone-style status bar using an Accessibility Service overlay, which is the only Android mechanism that lets a transparent bar sit above other apps without a permanent notification. Turn on \"iOS Status Bar Overlay\" under Accessibility to enable it. No screen content is read or recorded — the service only watches for the notification shade opening/closing so it can hide the overlay at the right moment.
Draws a transparent, iPhone-style status bar overlay at the top of the screen and hides it automatically while you have the notification shade open. Does not read or record screen content.
